title: Spindle Bearing Vibration — Major Threshold Exceeded
description: Spindle bearing vibration P004 = {val} mm/s exceeds ISO 10816-3 Zone C limit (7.1 mm/s). Kurtosis index P064 = {val2} indicates bearing defect frequency component present.
probable_cause: Bearing inner or outer race defect, ball spall, or loss of preload. Consistent with tool_wear or spindle_bearing_fault events in operational data.
diagnostic_steps: Capture vibration spectrum via on-machine sensor
Compare dominant frequency to bearing defect frequencies (BPFO, BPFI, BSF)
Check spindle thermal growth compensation active
Review trend for P004 over prior 30 days
remedy: Schedule spindle bearing replacement within 8 hours. Reduce spindle speed by 30% until replacement. Do not run over 6000 RPM.
required_action: Stop current operation. Machine must be inspected before resuming production.
